title: Step 2 — Named manifests
body:
# Step 2 — Named manifests

Keep Step 1 working and implement `blobstore.manifests`. Provide
`ManifestStore(root, objects)` with `create`, `get`, `delete`, `iter_names`,
and `referenced_ids`. Validate safe hierarchical names, object IDs, existence,
and digest integrity before publishing canonical JSON atomically. Duplicate
identical creation is idempotent; conflicting replacement is rejected.
